c13565315.notes: Green board with gold serif letters on two posts in front of the stone museum building, Charlestown, Nevis (camera 17.1405, -62.6298), seen at an angle from below. 'ALEXANDER HAMILTON' is arched over 'BIRTHPLACE'. A small white notice on the gate at left is unreadable.

c54615804.notes: Maroon fascia sign hung under the balcony of a three-storey wooden building on Fort Street, Basseterre (camera 17.2955, -62.7238), seen at a steep angle. Left panel is an interlocked monogram (read as O/A/E/G) over 'ESQUIRE'; the monogram reading is uncertain. Distractors: pink 'LIME' street banner, an event banner, 'Fort Street Ice cream Parlour' and 'Daily Basics' shop signs. Pedestrians and a van with a plate are incidental.

c54616217.notes: White panel with dark green letters across the facade of a pink three-storey building on Church Street, Basseterre (camera 17.2950, -62.7250); frontal. Parked cars in the foreground.

c54616243.notes: Trilingual 'Explore St. Kitts' heritage board in front of the church, Middle Island, St. Thomas parish (camera 17.3271, -62.8144), shot through a car window behind a green railing. Only the title is transcribed; below it are three paragraphs (English, French, Spanish) about Sir Thomas Warner and Samuel Jefferson, partly hidden by the railing. 'EXPLORE St. Kitts' logo at top left.

c32830709.reason: airport name letters 'VANCE W. AMORY INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT' photographed from behind, so all text is mirror-reversed; not usable as OCR ground truth

c36259963.notes: Hanging white sign with red frame on a bracket off the balcony of a wooden house in Basseterre (no camera location); seen from below at an angle. Phone digits are small; '2278' could be '2276' at this resolution. The suitcase on the pavement is incidental.

c36259982.reason: biography board 'HON. E.O CHALLENGER ... A LEGISLATOR ARCHAEOLOGIST ...' at the International House Museum; describes a person, and the site's name board is accepted from c36259984

c36259983.reason: painted portrait mural of Edgar Challenger with 'HISTORIAN / BORN 29TH.NOV.1905 / DIED 28 NOV. 2000'; a person's face is the subject, no place name

c36259984.notes: Hand-painted multicoloured board on a wall in Basseterre (no camera location); each line in a different colour and font. Flag labels on the right ('UNION JACK', 'STATEHOOD FLAG', 'NATIONAL FLAG') and the lower board 'HISTORICAL & CULTURAL & EDUCATIONAL RESEARCH + DOCUMENT UNIVERSITY' are distractors, as are the painted portrait boards at left with name plates 'EDGAR OSCAR CHALLENGER' and 'EDGAR WINSTON ZACK / CHALLENGER NISBETT'.

c59101870.notes: Green overhead arch sign with white condensed letters and up-arrows at each end, over the pedestrian walkway at Port Zante, Basseterre (no camera location). Distractors: 'COFFEE SHOP' giant-cup sign at left, 'DUTY FREE' awnings at right, a brand list board.

c59101874.notes: Engraved white-marble dedication plaque set in a wall recess, Basseterre (no camera location); frontal and sharp. Some letters have worn fill (the P in COMPLEX and OPENED look like 'F'/'C'), but the words are clear. The building name is in the first line; the rest is commemorative text.

c59101878.notes: Colourful beach-scene fascia sign with multicoloured bubble letters over a duty-free shop at Port Zante, Basseterre (no camera location); the same name appears on a smaller board at left. Tiny product list on the right board is not transcribed. Distractors: 'Life is good. OFFICIAL RETAILER' board, 'SALE KEYCHAINS $1 ...' and 'NO VAT FOR LOCALS' standees, 'DUTY FREE TAX FREE' window decal, watch adverts. Tourists in the foreground are incidental.

c59101881.reason: shop-door banners for CompuZone are mostly brand/service advertising (Dell, HP, Apple, Microsoft...); a seated man is the visual subject

c629444.notes: White panel with a crest and navy letters over the entrance of the stone police station in Basseterre (no camera location); frontal but the sign is small in the frame. A police officer at the door is incidental. Distractor: a vertical blue election banner 'VOTE PHILLIP BROWNE' on the pole at right.

c36259989.reason: near-duplicate of c36259982 (same 'HON. E.O. CHALLENGER' biography board); describes a person, not a place

c36401824.notes: Dark serif metal letters on the cream facade of a three-storey government building in Basseterre (no camera location), seen at an angle from street level; a St Kitts and Nevis flag hangs beside 'GOVERNMENT'. Parked cars with number plates are incidental, not the subject.

c59101888.notes: Black awning with white serif letters and a large 'Di' monogram (diamond icon over the i) at Port Zante, Basseterre (no camera location). The awning also lists watch/jewellery brands (BVLGARI, FOREVERMARK, BULOVA, BREITLING, LONGINES, ZENITH, MOVADO, TAG Heuer ...), which are advertising distractors. Other distractors: 'Restaurant & Sports Bar', 'TWIST RESTAURANT', 'BAR LOUNGE TWIST GLOBAL CUISINE', 'JEWEL PALACE', 'KAY'S FINE JEWELRY'. Passers-by are incidental.
